question_stem: As shown in the diagram, a particle $A$ of mass $1.6$ kg lies on a horizontal plane and a particle $B$ of mass $2.4$ kg lies on a plane inclined at an angle of $30^{\circ}$ to the horizontal. The particles are connected by a light inextensible string which passes over a small smooth pulley $P$ fixed at the top of the inclined plane. The distance $AP$ is $2.5$ m and the distance of $B$ from the bottom of the inclined plane is $1$ m. There is a barrier at the bottom of the inclined plane preventing any further motion of $B$. The part $BP$ of the string is parallel to a line of greatest slope of the inclined plane. The particles are released from rest with both parts of the string taut.

parts.label: (i)
parts.question_text: Given that both planes are smooth, find the acceleration of $A$ and the tension in the string.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.question_text: It is given instead that the horizontal plane is rough and that the coefficient of friction between $A$ and the horizontal plane is $0.2$. The inclined plane is smooth. Find the total distance travelled by $A$.
